title: Kubernetes, minus the nodes.
label: AWS EKS · Fargate
desc: A containerized 2048 game deployed to Amazon EKS with Fargate, ingress-based external access, and IAM/OIDC configuration for service-account permissions.

detail.focus: Explore container delivery on managed Kubernetes without maintaining EC2 worker nodes.
steps: Deploy a containerized 2048 application to Amazon EKS.
Use Fargate profiles for pod compute.
Configure ingress and load-balancer access.
Associate IAM permissions with service accounts through OIDC.
detail.learn: Brings together workload deployment, external routing, and AWS identity configuration.
detail.scope: Hands-on AWS deployment project; no uptime or cost-savings claim is made.

title: A blueprint for the cloud.
label: AWS infrastructure · CI/CD
desc: An end-to-end infrastructure pipeline with Jenkins on EC2, Terraform-provisioned EKS, and an NGINX deployment using Kubernetes manifests.

detail.focus: Turn repeatable AWS infrastructure provisioning into a version-controlled pipeline.
steps: Define EC2, VPC, and EKS resources in Terraform.
Host Jenkins on EC2 and connect the repository.
Store Terraform state in S3.
Run provisioning stages and deploy an NGINX workload.
detail.learn: Connects infrastructure definitions, pipeline orchestration, and Kubernetes deployment.
detail.scope: Repository includes setup screenshots and troubleshooting notes. Quantified performance claims are intentionally omitted.

title: See beyond the deployment.
label: GitOps · Observability
desc: A containerized website delivered through Argo CD, with Prometheus and Grafana dashboards to explore pod-level CPU and memory metrics.

detail.focus: Connect GitOps delivery to visibility into Kubernetes workload behavior.
steps: Build a Docker image and publish it to Docker Hub.
Sync Kubernetes manifests through Argo CD.
Install kube-prometheus-stack using Helm.
Explore pod CPU and memory metrics with PromQL and Grafana.
detail.learn: Demonstrates the relationship between resource configuration, metric collection, and dashboard queries.
detail.scope: Documented learning project; diagrams and animations on this portfolio are not live telemetry.

title: Security is part of the pipeline.
label: DevSecOps · Automation
desc: A Jenkins-driven delivery workflow combining code quality checks, dependency and container scanning, GitOps deployment, and monitoring.

detail.focus: Integrate code quality, dependency analysis, and image scanning into delivery.
steps: Orchestrate the workflow in Jenkins.
Check code with SonarQube and dependencies with OWASP Dependency-Check.
Scan images using Trivy and Docker Scout.
Deploy with Helm and Argo CD; explore Prometheus and Grafana monitoring.
detail.learn: Shows how security checks fit into a broader build-and-release workflow.
detail.scope: A hands-on DevSecOps implementation; it is not a security audit or guarantee that an application is vulnerability-free.

title: Less server. More possibility.
label: AWS · Serverless
desc: A serverless web application connecting S3 and CloudFront hosting to an API Gateway and Lambda backend with DynamoDB storage.

detail.focus: Build a web application using managed AWS services rather than a traditional application server.
steps: Host frontend files in S3 and distribute them with CloudFront.
Route application requests through API Gateway.
Handle requests with Lambda functions.
Persist application data in DynamoDB.
detail.learn: Connects static delivery, API routing, compute, and storage in a serverless architecture.
detail.scope: Project architecture and setup are documented in the repository. No current live-demo availability is assumed.

title: From commit to cluster.
label: Containers · GitOps
desc: A containerized web application with GitHub Actions, Docker Hub, Kubernetes manifests, Helm packaging, and Argo CD deployment.

detail.focus: Connect application changes to a container-based GitOps delivery workflow.
steps: Package the application with Docker.
Automate image builds and publishing through GitHub Actions.
Define workloads using Kubernetes manifests and Helm.
Use Argo CD to sync deployment configuration.
detail.learn: Explores the boundary between CI builds and GitOps-driven deployment.
detail.scope: Repository includes configuration, setup steps, and troubleshooting guidance.

title: Small app. Real delivery.
label: Team project · In development
desc: A team-built Node.js and Express task API with unit tests, Docker packaging, and a GitHub Actions pipeline configuration. DynamoDB integration is planned.

detail.focus: Develop a cloud-ready task application as a team project, with an automated delivery foundation.
steps: Implement a Node.js and Express REST API for task operations.
Add unit tests for application behavior.
Create a Dockerfile for consistent packaging.
Define GitHub Actions pipeline configuration.
detail.learn: Connects application development, testing, packaging, and CI configuration.
detail.scope: Team project with Neha Mishra and Ansh Pandit, guided by Prof. Natwar Jha. DynamoDB integration is planned, not presented as complete.
